reason: The test at testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/webauthn/passwordless/PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:279-283 configures the realm only with `setWebAuthnPolicyPasskeysEnabled(Boolean.FALSE)`, yet its name and the inline comment at line 304 say passkeys are hidden because "this user does not have passkey". The case of a passkey-less user re-authenticating with passkeys enabled is therefore never exercised.
